name: nnInteractive
prompt: one positive point at the annotated nodule center

training.QIBA: No (32 of 52 nodules in a developer test set)

references: Isensee F, Rokuss M, Krämer L, Dinkelacker S, Ravindran A, Stritzke F, et al. nnInteractive: redefining 3D promptable segmentation. arXiv [Preprint]. Posted March 11, 2025. Accessed November 16, 2026. doi:10.48550/arXiv.2503.08373

name: TotalSegmentator
prompt: no nodule location (its lung nodule task)
references: Wasserthal J, Breit HC, Meyer MT, Pradella M, Hinck D, Sauter AW, et al. TotalSegmentator: robust segmentation of 104 anatomic structures in CT images. Radiol Artif Intell 2023;5(5):e230024. doi:10.1148/ryai.230024

Wasserthal J. TotalSegmentator: lung_nodules task (provided by BLUEMIND AI; trained on 1353 subjects, partly from LIDC-IDRI) [Software]. GitHub. https://github.com/wasserth/TotalSegmentator. Accessed November 16, 2026.

name: MedSAM2
prompt: one positive point (point on the center section)
references: Ma J, Yang Z, Kim S, Chen B, Baharoon M, Fallahpour A, et al. MedSAM2: segment anything in 3D medical images and videos. arXiv [Preprint]. Posted April 4, 2025. Accessed November 16, 2026. doi:10.48550/arXiv.2504.03600

name: PiNS
prompt: the point and a box giving the nodule extent
references: Tushar FI. PiNS: Point-driven Nodule Segmentation Toolkit (Version 1.0) [Software]. Zenodo; 2025. doi:10.5281/zenodo.17171571. https://github.com/fitushar/PiNS. Accessed November 16, 2026.

name: VoxTell
references: Rokuss M, Langenberg M, Kirchhoff Y, Isensee F, Hamm B, Ulrich C, et al. VoxTell: free-text promptable universal 3D medical image segmentation. In: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR). 2026;37538–37557.

name: VISTA3D-Auto
prompt: no nodule location (its lung tumor class and no point)
references: He Y, Guo P, Tang Y, Myronenko A, Nath V, Xu Z, et al. VISTA3D: a unified segmentation foundation model for 3D medical imaging. In: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR). 2025;20863–20873. doi:10.1109/CVPR52734.2025.01943

name: VISTA3D-Point
prompt: one positive point at the annotated nodule center
references: He Y, Guo P, Tang Y, Myronenko A, Nath V, Xu Z, et al. VISTA3D: a unified segmentation foundation model for 3D medical imaging. In: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR). 2025;20863–20873. doi:10.1109/CVPR52734.2025.01943
